name: okf-doc-style
description: Author or convert a knowledge corpus into Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2: a 9-step runbook covering bundle layout, frontmatter families (provenance, trust, lifecycle, attested computation), actor and path conventions, and index/log files, plus a mechanical conformance pass (K1–K8) shipped as stdlib scripts (okf_lint.py + okf_parse.py). Reads and writes markdown documents only; executes nothing.
